rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the hymn
first member of instrumental compound with mātreṇa
final member indicating mere extent or sufficiency
refers to future people mentioned in prior verse

items.question: What simple means ensures spiritual welfare for future generations of devotees?
premises: Future people may lack direct access to teachers or rituals.
This hymn possesses inherent spiritual efficacy.
Mere recitation of this hymn constitutes sufficient practice.
items.inference: Therefore mere recitation of this hymn will bring welfare to them.
uncertainties: The exact referent of asya as this hymn or a broader teaching is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: By the mere recitation of this alone, welfare will come to them.
